title: Lampang — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lampang: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lampang has a population of 55,000. A charming northern Thai city known for its horse-drawn carriages, the Wat Phra That Lampang Luang temple, and its historic ceramic industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 143 sunny days a year.
